item.title: LIVE: Lion vs Hyena — Africa's Deadliest Rivalry
item.description:
LIVE: Lion vs Hyena — Africa's Deadliest Rivalry — real predator confrontations from across the African wild, plus the wildlife facts behind why these animals fight the way they do.
Join this live stream as we break down real footage of Africa's fiercest animal encounters — lions, hyenas, crocodiles, leopards, and more — and explain the actual biology and survival strategy behind each fight, not just the highlight reel. Expect real confrontations, real stakes, and the science behind who actually wins and why.
Nature Frontiers brings you real wildlife science — no cartoons, no filler, just the natural world at its most extreme. Subscribe for new apex predator breakdowns every week.
